meta.title: Traffic Light: green band is inclusive of the entered value
gaps: Observe and assert that the vendor bidding exactly at the green boundary shows green while the vendor bidding above it does not.
Directly inspect the traffic-light colour for the surrogate bid in the buyer view.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Observe and assert that the vendor bidding exactly at the green boundary shows green while the vendor bidding above it does not.; Directly inspect the traffic-light colour for the surrogate bid in the buyer view.

steps.note: Start the single-stage auction creation flow where traffic-light strategy is configurable.
Configure a buy traffic-light auction with green inclusive through 100 and a valid upper bound.
Apply the first available auction template before adding line items.
Add one product for the bids.
Invite two vendors so one can bid exactly at the boundary and the other above it.
Verify that the auction reached a published project page.
Have the first vendor submit a bid exactly at the green boundary.
Verify that the boundary bid was accepted.
Submit a second vendor bid just above the green boundary using the buyer console.
Verify that the above-boundary bid was accepted.

args.need: inspect the rendered traffic-light colours and confirm the vendor at price 100 is green while the vendor at price 101 is not green

steps.note: No catalog assertion reads traffic-light colours, so tester inspection is required for the case's oracle.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or invalid rendered values.
